_meta.name: Demo: Gatwick 26L evening arrivals
_meta.note: Initial states for the 3-minute demo. Positions at real STAR fixes; levels/headings plausible for a sim, not real procedure values.
_meta.injects_note: Each inject maps 1:1 to a contracts.py call at sim time t_s. call=force_error -> PilotEngine.force_error(mode, kind, callsign); call=inject -> World.inject(kind, callsign, params).
_meta.departures_note: Optional list 'departures': [{callsign, type, sid, persona, release_not_before_s}] queues departures at the holding point. Left empty so the demo opening stays exactly the five scripted arrivals; use the spawn_departure inject for the departure beat.
_meta.weather_note: Visibility/cloud/temperature for the SIMULATED METAR (World.metar()). Wind and QNH come from wind/qnh above so the METAR matches how aircraft fly.
